warnings: Upper-floor sanitary plan. It is a thin sheet by design -- only one wet room upstairs, so almost everything is concentrated in the ช่องท่อ duct beside the bathroom.

*** A LEVEL DISAGREEMENT WITH THE ARCHITECTURAL SET: this sheet tags the upper bathroom +3.40, but A-06 gives +3.35 and A-27/A-28 detail TWO levels inside it, +3.35 dry and +3.33 wet with a printed SLOPE arrow and a 0.05 fall. *** The sanitary drawing has simply used the general floor level. The architectural sheets are the authority on finished levels (they carry the fall and the section), so this is recorded as printed and flagged rather than corrected.
The vent stack terminates in a ø2" AVC cast-iron cap. SN-01's legend distinguishes a top-vent AVC from a side-vent AVC by drawn symbol only, and the size tag alone does not say which is used here.
The ø3"RD+RL at the balcony corner stacks directly over the ø3"RL shown at the same corner on SN-04 -- one downpipe through both floors.
The dimension grid is identical to A-06 including the 2.40/0.20/2.40 stair-well sub-chain and the 2.20/2.80 split of the C-D bay, so sanitary and architecture agree on the set-out.
The roof east of grid 3 is drawn hatched with SLOPE 25° arrows for reference, exactly as on A-06.
